fusions.name: Clear the Board
fusions.desc: Flings a blade that deals 16 damage to the first enemy it meets and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Carving Round
fusions.desc: Cuts a full circle, which deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and makes them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Topping-Out Supper
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Stocked Larder
fusions.desc: When you are healed, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
